## Workload

During the review period, grader Tomas Brennan completed 267 reads, recording 472 hours of work. This represents a rate of 0.6 reads per hour. The workload figures provide the basis for assessing activity over the period and are recorded for review alongside the quality findings.

## Quality

A sample of 20 reads was checked as part of the review. The level of agreement was 60.0 per cent. These results should be considered together with the recorded workload when assessing the grader’s performance.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The workload and quality information have been documented for consideration in the ongoing review process.
